name: aaron_marketing_skills_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the aaron_marketing_skills capability.

prompts.name: generate_marketing_content
prompts.template: Create marketing content for a {marketing_objective} targeting {target_audience} with focus on {discipline}.
prompts.use_case: Creating multi-channel marketing campaigns with AI-generated content and strategy.

prompts.name: audit_campaign
prompts.template: Audit the campaign content using the {audit_gate} gate and provide an evaluation report.
prompts.use_case: Performing quality audits on marketing materials to comply with branding and effectiveness standards.

prompts.name: optimize_performance
prompts.template: Given performance metrics {performance_metrics}, provide recommendations to improve ROAS and engagement.
prompts.use_case: Optimizing SEO and GEO-targeted campaigns using integrated AI skills and audits.

prompts.name: multi_channel_strategy
prompts.template: Develop a multi-channel marketing strategy for {marketing_objective} across SEO, social, email, paid, and influencer channels.
prompts.use_case: Managing influencer outreach and paid media strategies through AI-supported workflows.
